fix_summary: available() assumes stock.get(sku) returns a record and immediately subscripts it. When the SKU is missing (e.g., discontinued), stock.get(sku) returns None and record["on_hand"] raises a TypeError. Update available() to handle a missing SKU by treating it as zero available, e.g., use a default of {"on_hand": 0, "reserved": 0} in stock.get or return 0 when record is None.
